description: Show your VsSodium activity in Discord.
enabledSetting: Share your VsSodium activity with Discord. Requires the Discord desktop app to be running.
applicationIdSetting: Application ID from your Discord Developer Portal application.
iconAssetKeySetting: Rich Presence art asset key uploaded to your Discord application. The default key is vssodium.
showFileNameSetting: Show the active file name in Discord. Disabled by default for privacy.
